answer_1.quote: We use GELI to learn a reward function based on the overall affect of the user ... and evaluate on two datasets for the generated dialogue. ... We are interested in generating conversational responses with an autoregressive language model in a multi-sensory setting.

answer_4.quote: We run a human study based on the 8 metrics commonly used in literature to evaluate the quality of the generated utterances. We recruited a total of 300 crowd workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to rate which model(s) satisfied each given criterion and which chatbot they would talk to again.
